extra_vocab.en: to fix something firmly so it cannot move or come loose
extra_vocab.note: 在文章裡指用 LATCH 接頭把迷你底座牢牢固定在汽座上。secure A to B 是產品說明常見的動作用語，強調「固定得穩」。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: secure A to B 表示把 A 固定在 B 上；secure 後面若接 contract、funding 等，意思就變成「取得、爭取到」，要看受詞判斷。

example.en: A strong lock secures the warehouse door at night.
example.zh: 一把堅固的鎖在夜間固定住倉庫的門。

example.en: The workers secured the boxes with strong tape yesterday.
example.zh: 工人昨天用強力膠帶把箱子固定好了。

example.en: Securing the load properly takes only a few minutes.
example.zh: 把貨物妥善固定只需要幾分鐘。

example.en: The startup is trying to secure funding for its new product.
example.zh: 這家新創公司正努力為新產品取得資金。

example.en: She worked hard to secure a contract with the airline.
example.zh: 她努力爭取到與航空公司的合約。

example.en: Guards secure the building after all employees have left.
example.zh: 員工全部離開後，警衛會鎖好整棟建築。

examples.en: Please secure all windows before you leave the office.
examples.zh: 離開辦公室前，請把所有窗戶關好。

examples.en: Please secure the budget approval before we sign the order.
examples.zh: 簽訂訂單前，請先取得預算核准。

examples.en: We hope to secure a larger order from this client.
examples.zh: 我們希望從這位客戶那裡取得更大的訂單。

examples.en: Make sure you secure the car seat before you drive.
examples.zh: 開車前請確認已經把汽座固定好。

confusable.diff: ensure 是「確保」，發音和 secure 相近，但不是把東西固定住。

example.en: Please ensure that all doors are locked at night.
example.zh: 請確保所有的門在夜間都已上鎖。

confusable.diff: insure 是「投保」，發音也和 secure 相近。

example.en: We need to insure the equipment before shipping it overseas.
example.zh: 我們需要在把設備運往海外前先為它投保。

similar.diff: fasten 強調扣緊、繫上（如安全帶）；secure 強調固定到穩固不動。

example.en: Please fasten your seat belt before the plane takes off.
example.zh: 飛機起飛前請繫好安全帶。

similar.diff: attach 只表示接上或附上，不一定牢固。

example.en: Please attach the receipt to the expense report.
example.zh: 請把收據附在費用報告上。

example.en: Please lock the door when you leave the room.
example.zh: 離開房間時請把門鎖上。

example.en: This case will protect your laptop during the trip.
example.zh: 這個保護殼會在旅途中保護你的筆電。

example.en: The new design is safe for babies of all ages.
example.zh: 這款新設計對各年齡的嬰兒都很安全。

example.en: Please secure the shelf to the wall with two screws.
example.zh: 請用兩根螺絲把架子固定在牆上。

example.en: Use a secure password to protect your online account.
example.zh: 請使用安全的密碼來保護你的網路帳號。

senses.en: to fix something firmly so it will not move

example.en: Workers secure the cargo with strong straps before shipping.
example.zh: 工人在出貨前用堅固的帶子固定貨物。

senses.en: to get something important after some effort
senses.distinguish: 受詞是 contract、funding、order 等抽象的商業成果時，意思是「取得」。

example.en: The sales team hopes to secure a new contract this month.
example.zh: 業務團隊希望這個月能取得一份新合約。

extra_vocab.en: to stretch your arm to touch or take something
extra_vocab.note: 在文章裡出現兩次：reach across 指伸手到另一側，harder to reach 指另一側比較不容易搆到。講者用它說明兩個按鈕相連的好處。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: reach 當「到達」時是及物動詞，後面直接接地點，不加 to 或 at：reach the airport，不說 reach to the airport。

example.en: The shuttle bus reaches the airport in thirty minutes.
example.zh: 接駁巴士三十分鐘就會抵達機場。

example.en: Our sales reached a new record last quarter.
example.zh: 我們的銷售額上一季創下新紀錄。

example.en: She is reaching for the phone on the desk.
example.zh: 她正伸手去拿桌上的電話。

example.en: Both sides hope to reach an agreement by Friday.
example.zh: 雙方希望在星期五之前達成協議。

example.en: Please reach out to our support team if you need help.
example.zh: 如果需要協助，請主動聯絡我們的支援團隊。

example.en: We hope to reach the target before the end of June.
example.zh: 我們希望在六月底前達成目標。

examples.en: We should reach the hotel before the rain starts.
examples.zh: 我們應該在下雨之前抵達飯店。

examples.en: Social media helps us reach more young customers.
examples.zh: 社群媒體幫助我們接觸到更多年輕客戶。

examples.en: The two teams could not reach a decision on the budget.
examples.zh: 兩個團隊無法就預算做出決定。

examples.en: Workers need a ladder to reach the highest shelves.
examples.zh: 工人需要梯子才能搆到最高的架子。

similar.diff: arrive 是不及物動詞，後面要接 at／in；reach 是及物動詞，直接接地點。

example.en: Most guests arrive at the hotel before noon on Friday.
example.zh: 大多數旅客會在星期五中午前抵達飯店。

similar.diff: get to 較口語，意思同「到達」，不用於「達成協議」這類抽象用法。

example.en: We should get to the venue by nine.
example.zh: 我們應該在九點前到達會場。

example.en: Please do not touch the screen with wet hands.
example.zh: 請不要用濕手觸碰螢幕。

example.en: Please contact the manager if the printer stops working.
example.zh: 如果印表機故障，請聯絡經理。

example.en: Stretch your arms during long meetings to stay alert.
example.zh: 在冗長的會議中伸展手臂以保持清醒。

example.en: The top shelf is too high for me to reach.
example.zh: 最上層的架子太高了，我搆不到。

example.en: Keep the first aid kit within reach of every worker.
example.zh: 請把急救箱放在每位工人伸手可及之處。

senses.en: to stretch out your arm to touch or take something

example.en: Please reach for the top button on the control panel.
example.zh: 請伸手按控制面板最上方的按鈕。

example.en: The package should reach your office by Thursday.
example.zh: 包裹應該會在星期四前送到你的辦公室。

senses.en: to speak to someone by phone or email
senses.distinguish: 受詞是人，且常和 by phone、at this number 一起出現。

example.en: You can reach me at this number after five.
example.zh: 五點後你可以用這個號碼聯絡到我。

senses.en: to get to a certain amount or level
senses.distinguish: 受詞是金額、數字或目標等抽象的量。

example.en: Online sales reached one million dollars this year.
example.zh: 今年網路銷售額達到了一百萬美元。

extra_vocab.en: the way something is tilted or turned
extra_vocab.note: 在文章裡，adjust the angle of the base 指調整底座的傾斜角度，讓它更貼合車用座椅。講者也把按鈕命名為 Latch Angle Adjustment。

example.en: The tablet stand has three adjustable angles for typing.
example.zh: 這個平板支架有三種可調整的打字角度。

example.en: Please adjust the angle of the camera before recording.
example.zh: 錄影前請先調整攝影機的角度。

example.en: The screen stands at an angle on the desk.
example.zh: 螢幕在桌上呈傾斜角度擺放。

example.en: The two walls meet at a right angle.
example.zh: 這兩面牆以直角相接。

example.en: Let's look at the problem from a different angle.
example.zh: 我們從不同的角度來看這個問題吧。

examples.en: The monitor can tilt to any angle you like.
examples.zh: 這台螢幕可以傾斜到你喜歡的任何角度。

examples.en: The camera angle makes the product look larger.
examples.zh: 拍攝角度讓產品看起來比較大。

examples.en: Set the chair at a comfortable angle for your back.
examples.zh: 把椅子調到對背部舒適的角度。

confusable.diff: angel 是「天使」，拼法和 angle 只差字母順序；商業上常說 angel investor（天使投資人）。

example.en: Our angel investor gave the startup its first funding.
example.zh: 我們的天使投資人給了這家新創公司第一筆資金。

similar.diff: viewpoint 只表示「觀點」；angle 除了角度，也可指看事情的切入點。

example.en: Each manager shared a different viewpoint on the plan.
example.zh: 每位經理對這個計畫都分享了不同的觀點。

example.en: The delivery truck stopped at the bottom of the slope.
example.zh: 送貨卡車停在斜坡底部。

example.en: Do not tilt the box when you carry it.
example.zh: 搬運箱子時請不要讓它傾斜。

example.en: The printer is in the corner of the meeting room.
example.zh: 印表機放在會議室的角落。

example.en: Turn the handle ninety degrees to lock the door.
example.zh: 把把手轉九十度就能鎖上門。

derived.link: tri- 表示三，加 angle 就是「三個角」，像 tricycle

senses.en: the amount something is tilted or turned

example.en: Please check the angle of the mirror before driving.
example.zh: 開車前請檢查後照鏡的角度。

senses.en: a way of thinking about something
senses.distinguish: 後面常接抽象的事，如 a new angle on the problem，指看事情的方式。

example.en: A new angle may help us sell this old product.
example.zh: 換個切入點也許能幫我們賣出這個舊產品。

extra_vocab.en: a soft bag used for sitting on or leaning against
extra_vocab.note: 在文章裡，vehicle seat cushion and backrest 指車用座椅的坐墊與椅背，是底座角度調整後要貼合的位置。

example.en: The hotel replaced all the sofa cushions in the lobby.
example.zh: 飯店更換了大廳所有的沙發坐墊。

example.en: A thick foam layer cushions the glass during shipping.
example.zh: 一層厚厚的泡棉在運送時為玻璃提供緩衝。

example.en: Extra savings cushioned the company during the slow season.
example.zh: 額外的存款在淡季時為公司提供了緩衝。

example.en: The soft packing prevents damage by cushioning the product.
example.zh: 柔軟的包材藉由緩衝產品來避免損壞。

example.en: The new seat cushion makes long meetings more comfortable.
example.zh: 新的座椅坐墊讓冗長的會議更舒適。

example.en: Strong packaging helps cushion the impact during delivery.
example.zh: 堅固的包裝有助於在運送時緩衝衝擊。

example.en: We sell a washable cushion cover for every size.
example.zh: 我們為每種尺寸都販售可水洗的坐墊套。

examples.en: The sofa has soft cushions and a wooden frame.
examples.zh: 這張沙發有柔軟的坐墊和木頭框架。

examples.en: She placed a cushion on her chair for support.
examples.zh: 她在椅子上放了一個坐墊來支撐。

examples.en: Foam pieces act as a cushion for fragile items.
examples.zh: 泡棉塊對易碎品起到緩衝的作用。

examples.en: A thick cushion keeps the baby comfortable on long trips.
examples.zh: 厚實的坐墊讓寶寶在長途旅行中保持舒適。

similar.diff: pillow 專指枕頭；cushion 是坐墊或靠墊。

example.en: The hotel provides two pillows for each guest bed.
example.zh: 飯店為每張客床提供兩個枕頭。

similar.diff: pad 是較薄的襯墊，常用來保護物品。

example.en: A foam pad protects the equipment during shipping.
example.zh: 泡棉墊在運送過程中保護設備。

example.en: Guests can ask for an extra pillow at the front desk.
example.zh: 旅客可以向櫃台要求多一個枕頭。

example.en: The company ships glasses in boxes filled with foam.
example.zh: 公司用裝滿泡棉的箱子運送玻璃杯。

example.en: This chair gives good support for your lower back.
example.zh: 這張椅子對下背部有很好的支撐。

example.en: Please put a cushion on the chair for the guest.
example.zh: 請在椅子上放個坐墊給客人。

example.en: The warehouse uses foam to cushion fragile products.
example.zh: 倉庫使用泡棉來緩衝易碎品。

senses.en: a soft bag used for sitting on or leaning against

example.en: A cushion on the chair makes long meetings easier.
example.zh: 椅子上的坐墊讓冗長的會議更輕鬆。

senses.en: extra money or time that protects you from problems
senses.distinguish: 後面常接 cash、time 等，指預留的緩衝，不是實體的軟墊。

example.en: A small cash cushion helps us during slow months.
example.zh: 一小筆現金緩衝能幫助我們度過淡季。

extra_vocab.en: to move something up from a lower place
extra_vocab.note: 在文章裡，lift the infant car seat off the base 指把汽座從底座上提起來，是取出寶寶時的最後一個動作。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: lift 是及物動詞，常用 lift + 物 + off／out／up 表示提到哪裡；off the base 是說「離開底座」。

example.en: The crane lifts heavy boxes onto the truck.
example.zh: 起重機把沉重的箱子吊到卡車上。

example.en: Two workers lifted the machine onto the table.
example.zh: 兩名工人把機器抬到桌上。

example.en: Lifting heavy boxes without help can cause injuries.
example.zh: 沒人幫忙獨自搬重箱子可能造成受傷。

example.en: Please lift up the lid and check inside.
example.zh: 請掀起蓋子檢查裡面。

example.en: The city plans to lift restrictions on outdoor events.
example.zh: 市政府計畫解除對戶外活動的限制。

example.en: Could you give me a lift to the airport?
example.zh: 你可以載我去機場嗎？

examples.en: Please lift the boxes carefully when you unload the truck.
examples.zh: 卸貨時請小心搬起這些箱子。

examples.en: Press the release button, then lift the car seat out.
examples.zh: 按下釋放按鈕，再把汽座提出來。

examples.en: The new ad campaign could lift our sales this quarter.
examples.zh: 新的廣告活動可能會提升我們這一季的銷售。

similar.diff: raise 常用於提高數字、價格或把東西舉高；lift 強調把東西從下往上抬離。

example.en: We plan to raise prices by five percent next year.
example.zh: 我們計畫明年把價格調漲百分之五。

similar.diff: pick up 是拿起、撿起，也可指接人；語氣比 lift 口語。

example.en: Please pick up the package at the front desk.
example.zh: 請到櫃台領取包裹。

example.en: The staff carry the luggage to each guest room.
example.zh: 員工把行李搬到每間客房。

example.en: Please hold the door open for the delivery driver.
example.zh: 請幫送貨司機扶著門。

example.en: We need to move the printer to the second floor.
example.zh: 我們需要把印表機搬到二樓。

example.en: Please lift the lid and check the filter inside.
example.zh: 請掀開蓋子檢查裡面的濾網。

example.en: The lift is out of order, so please use the stairs.
example.zh: 電梯故障了，請走樓梯。

senses.en: to move something up from a lower place

example.en: Lift the box with your legs, not with your back.
example.zh: 用腿的力量抬箱子，不要用背。

senses.en: to end a rule that stops people from doing something
senses.distinguish: 受詞是 ban、restriction 等規定，指「解除」。

example.en: The government decided to lift the travel ban.
example.zh: 政府決定解除旅遊禁令。

senses.en: to make something go higher in amount or level
senses.distinguish: 受詞是 sales、profits 等數字，指「提高」。

example.en: A new promotion could lift sales by ten percent.
example.zh: 新的促銷活動可能把銷售額提高百分之十。

extra_vocab.en: in a way that is easy, or only
extra_vocab.note: 在文章裡，simply click 的意思是「只要…就可以」，強調操作很簡單。講者多次用 simply 和 just，讓聽眾覺得步驟輕鬆。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: simply 通常放在動詞前，表示「只要…就好」；句首的 Simply put, ... 是「簡單來說」。

example.en: Simply put, the new base is smaller and lighter.
example.zh: 簡單來說，新的底座更小也更輕。

example.en: We chose this supplier simply because the price was lower.
example.zh: 我們選這家供應商只是因為價格比較低。

example.en: Simply click the link below to confirm your booking.
example.zh: 只要點擊下方連結就能確認你的訂位。

examples.en: Simply reply to this email if you need more details.
examples.zh: 如果你需要更多細節，只要回覆這封電子郵件即可。

examples.en: Simply press the button, and the door opens.
examples.zh: 只要按下按鈕，門就會打開。

examples.en: Let me explain the process as simply as possible.
examples.zh: 讓我盡可能簡單地說明這個流程。

examples.en: You simply need to sign the form at the counter.
examples.zh: 你只需要在櫃台簽署這份表格。

confusable.diff: simple 是形容詞（簡單的），simply 是副詞（簡單地、只要）。
confusable.usage: simple 修飾名詞（a simple form）；simply 修飾動詞或整句（simply click）。

example.en: The booking form is simple and easy to complete.
example.zh: 這份訂位表格簡單，很容易填寫。

confusable.diff: similarly 是「同樣地」，拼法和 simply 前半很像，意思不同。

example.en: Similarly, our new model is lighter than the old one.
example.zh: 同樣地，我們的新款比舊款更輕。

similar.diff: just 較口語，語氣和 simply 類似，常放在祈使句裡。

example.en: Just press the green button to start the machine.
example.zh: 只要按下綠色按鈕就能啟動機器。

similar.diff: merely 較正式，帶有「只不過」的語氣。

example.en: This is merely a draft, not the final report.
example.zh: 這只是草稿，不是最終報告。

example.en: We only need two signatures on this form.
example.zh: 這份表格我們只需要兩個簽名。

example.en: The base can be removed easily by one person.
example.zh: 這個底座一個人就能輕鬆取下。

example.en: Please reply quickly so we can confirm the order.
example.zh: 請盡快回覆，我們才能確認訂單。

derived.link: simply 的詞幹，simple 加 -ly（le 變 ly）變副詞，像 gentle → gently

example.en: To confirm your seat, simply show your ticket at the desk.
example.zh: 要確認座位，只要在櫃台出示機票即可。

senses.en: in a way that is easy to understand
senses.distinguish: 通常放在動詞後面，如 explain simply，指表達得淺顯易懂。

example.en: The manual explains each step simply and clearly.
example.zh: 這本手冊簡單明瞭地說明每個步驟。

senses.en: used to make a word stronger
senses.distinguish: 後面接形容詞，如 simply excellent，用來加強語氣。

example.en: The service at this hotel was simply excellent.
example.zh: 這間飯店的服務真的非常棒。
